statements.proposition: At the head commit, ruff lint passes and tests of the changed modules (postprocessing/preprocessing) pass with no regressions
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Lint checked with ruff 0.12.10 (current at head commit date 2025-08-30) and 0.13.3: both clean, check and format --check, whole repo with the repository's pyproject config (UP007 ignore removed in this PR). Latest ruff (0.17.x) reports unrelated new-rule findings (CPY001 copyright notice, others repo-wide), not related to the change; CI uses unpinned ruff-action. Tests: only the postprocessing/preprocessing tests were run (32 passed); the full suite needs OpenFOAM and was not run, but the statement says only 'basic functionality tests'.
